description: Import AI-assistant chat exports (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) and agent session transcripts into the brain as one dated page per conversation under conversations/, validate each page against the native conversation parser, extract facts via the native conversation-facts flow, and keep the archive gap-free with a detect-and-backfill loop.
